messages:
Alex: Start thread for Nimbus POC decisioning. Key constraints: EU-only data, BYOK, 10-day POC, budget ~$3k. Need hosting recommendation and SOW success criteria.
Nora: I'll own prompts/evals. Main flows: invoice Q&A + vector search. Want recall@5 >= 0.9 and stable billing explanation outputs.
Ben: Security: BYOK on Dedicated/Private. Hosted can use CMK in eu-west with addendum; need SOC2 and pen-test. I'll send sec questionnaire to carol@nim-finops.com.
Sam: Infra: For predictable p95 <300ms at 256 tokens recommend Dedicated in eu-west-1. Hosted is fastest to start but no SLA. Private not possible in 10 days.
Priya: Pricing: offer $3k hosted credits or discounted Dedicated trial rate (estimate pending finance). Recommend we present both options in SOW.
Nora: Proposed success criteria: recall@5 >=0.9; embeddings p95 <120ms; gen p95 <300ms at 256 tokens; <1% error rate; KMS rotation + logs to their SIEM.
Alex: Timeline: Day0-2 contracts; Day3-4 infra + smoke; Day5-9 run evals; Day10 handoff. Can Sam confirm Dedicated provisioning ETA after PO?
Sam: Yes ~48-72h after PO for a small Dedicated cluster. infra-bot: Ticket #POC-4801 created for Dedicated eu-west-1 trial.
Ben: I've sent the questionnaire and requested SOC2 report. Carol acknowledged and will share docs.
Priya: I'll prepare evals and a small load script. Will post curl samples and measurement checklist by EOD.
Alex: Great. I'll draft SOW language for fallback (Dedicated -> Hosted) and data residency addendum.
